per_question.question: How do I reset a forgotten password?
per_question.answer: To reset a forgotten password, use the self-service password reset portal at https://reset.acme.example. You will need to answer your security questions or use the authenticator app registered on your account. If you are locked out of the authenticator app, contact the IT service desk on extension 4400, and identity verification in person is required before a reset is issued.

per_question.question: How long must a company password be and when does it expire?
per_question.answer: A company password must be at least 14 characters long and expires every 12 months.

per_question.question: How often must employees complete security awareness training?
per_question.answer: Employees must complete security awareness training every 6 months after their initial training within 30 days of joining.

per_question.question: What is the daily meal reimbursement limit for business travel?
per_question.answer: The daily meal reimbursement limit for business travel is £35.

per_question.question: What is the annual leave carry-over limit and when must security training be completed?
per_question.answer: The annual leave carry-over limit is 5 days, and security training must be completed within 30 days of joining and every 6 months thereafter.

per_question.question: What is the sick leave self-certification period and the incident reporting timeframe?
per_question.answer: The sick leave self-certification period is up to 7 calendar days. The incident reporting timeframe for security incidents is immediate reporting to security@acme.example.

per_question.question: What should I do if the VPN disconnects after a few minutes?
per_question.answer: Ensure your system clock is synchronized automatically; incorrect time breaks certificate validation.

per_question.question: How do I regain access when locked out of the authenticator app?
per_question.answer: To regain access when locked out of the authenticator app, contact the IT service desk on extension 4400. Identity verification in person is required before a reset is issued.

per_question.question: Is split tunnelling allowed on the VPN?
per_question.answer: Split tunnelling is disabled on all profiles; all traffic from a VPN session is routed through company infrastructure.

per_question.question: How do I get network access when the VPN says 'Access denied'?
per_question.answer: Your manager must request network access through the access request form before the account is enabled.

per_question.question: What are the remote working rules and what does security require of devices?
per_question.answer: Remote working allows employees to work up to three days per week by agreement with their line manager, and these days must be recorded in the shared team calendar. Security requires that only company-managed devices may connect to the corporate VPN, which must have disk encryption enabled and the endpoint protection agent running. Personal devices are not permitted on the VPN.

per_question.question: How do I request leave, and who do I contact if I am locked out of my account?
per_question.answer: To request leave, you must use the HR portal at least two weeks in advance for absences of three days or more. If you are locked out of your account, you should contact the IT service desk on extension 4400.

per_question.question: Can I use my personal laptop to connect to the VPN?
per_question.answer: No, personal laptops and phones are not permitted on the VPN under any circumstances.
